title: A responsible-play break could be shortened by choosing a shorter break
reproduce: Account → Responsible play → take a 7-day break, then submit the form again with 1 day: excluded_until moved from +7 days to +1 day.
fix: start_break() only ever extends the break (keeps the later end date); message now states the end date and that breaks can't be shortened.

title: Sitemap code contradicted its description (180-day cut-off computed but never used)
reproduce: app/routes.py sitemap(): unused 'cutoff'; docstring said results drop out after 180 days.
fix: Behaviour kept (results are a permanent archive); dead code removed and description corrected.

title: Unused variables/imports left in routes, control, checks
fix: Removed the unused variables that could hide logic slips; no undefined names exist.
retest: pyflakes: no undefined names; suite passes

title: One approved large wallet adjustment could be applied several times when approved at the same moment
found_by: tests/race_audit.py S11 (8 simultaneous approvals → customer credited 3×)
reproduce: Two admins (or a double-click) press Approve on the same request at once.
fix: decide() now checks, carries out and records the approval in one locked database transaction; executors run inside it.
retest: S11 PASS (1 ledger line); QA-RACE-02 passes

title: Refunding unspent deposits sent the card refund to Stripe once per click (6 clicks → 6 refunds of £20)
reproduce: Press 'Refund unspent deposits' repeatedly / in two tabs at once.
fix: Refund reserved in the wallet ledger inside a locked transaction before Stripe is called; Stripe Idempotency-Key on every refund; failed card refund puts the money back.

title: A deposit refund racing a purchase could refund money that had just been spent on entries
reproduce: Refund unspent deposits while a checkout paid from the same deposit runs.
fix: Same reservation-first design as BUG-005: the refund amount is worked out and taken from the wallet in the same locked transaction.

title: Duplicate Stripe webhooks for a credit-card payment sent the automatic refund up to 10 times
reproduce: Stripe delivers the same checkout.session.completed event several times at once for a credit-card payment.
fix: Refusal claims a one-time key (once_keys table) before refunding; Stripe Idempotency-Key per checkout/deposit.

title: A double-submitted redraw ran several redraws (6 submissions → 5 redraws, winner changed 5 times)
reproduce: Press Redraw several times quickly or submit the same form twice.
fix: Redraw form carries the id of the result it replaces (now required); the redraw runs only if that is still the current result, inside one transaction.
retest: S7b round 1 PASS (1 redraw); QA-RACE-01 passes

title: Wallet adjustment / goodwill forms could be applied twice by a double-click or refresh
found_by: Code review during the race audit
reproduce: Double-click 'Adjust' on a customer's admin page.
fix: One-time form token checked server-side; a repeat shows 'already done'.

title: Reports and Compliance pages had a page section pasted into the <title> and <head> (garbled tab title, duplicate ids)
reproduce: Open Admin → Reports or Compliance; look at the tab title / page source.
fix: Stray copies removed; regression test checks every page title is plain text and ids are unique.

title: Cookie policy didn't mention the session-storage item used by the Back button
Wallet page scrolled sideways on 320px-wide phones
reproduce: Open My account → Wallet at 320px width.
fix: Balance cards can shrink; smaller padding/fonts under 360px.

title: Admin competition page and Reports scrolled sideways on phones
reproduce: Open an admin competition or Reports at 320–414px.
fix: Prize table and report panels scroll inside their box; admin dropdowns fit the screen.
